description: Deliberate mistakes, each named in plain words, around a few steps that work. 20 sts are cast on; 4 are bound off at the start of a right-side row (1 st stays on the right needle) and the row is knit to the end, leaving 16 and a wrong-side row next. Chart row 1 is drawn as a right-side row of 20, so working it here is refused: its side is wrong and it does not take the 16 waiting; nothing is applied. Binding off 30, holding 25, turning past the last stitch, a short row with nothing past its turn, and three returns of held stitches that cannot happen (the hold step is gone, its hold failed, or it comes later) are refused and change nothing. A wrap-and-turn short row on the wrong side leaves 5 sts waiting at the start edge; 3 sts go on hold and come straight back (the step says the WS faces you on a RS row), a second return of the same group is refused, and a row that says to work the wraps crosses none, so the section ends with short rows not worked across. An unchecked step that does not say how it changes the stitch count makes every count after it unknown. Chart rows 2 and 3 are not worked by any section, and row 3's repeat is worked 0 times, which validation reports for every chart row.
covers: bind off at the start of a row
chart row side and count mismatch
binding off or holding more than is left in the row
a short row with nothing past the turn
returning a group that does not exist, failed, is held later, or was already returned
short rows left unresolved at the end of a section
an unchecked step without a stitch change
chart row repeats still checked with sections
